raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Bodyweight Strength Programme (no equipment)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Progressive bodyweight strength for a beginner with minimal equipment"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation Push & Pull (Mon)":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Push-up regression 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Doorway row (tuck variant) 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Hip bridge 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch chest/shoulder 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Foundation Lower & Core (Wed)":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Squat to chair 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Romanian hinge (superman/hip extension) 3x10..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          Plank 3x20..40 seconds rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          lower body stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 45m "Push/Pull Progression (Fri)":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Incline push-up (hands on chair/step) 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Doorway row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Bird dog 3x10 per side rpe 3 rest 40 seconds
        cooldown:
          full body mobility 5 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Push Strength 2.0 (Mon)":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Push-up 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Doorway row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Hip bridge march 3x12..20 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest/shoulder stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Lower Strength & Core 2.0":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Squat to chair 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Hip hinge hold 3x20 seconds rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          Side plank 3x20 seconds per side rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          lower body mobility 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 45m "Pull Emphasis & Core 2.0":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Inverted row under table (tuck) 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Push-up to decline (feet elevated on a step if safe) 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Mountain climber slow 3x20 seconds rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          full body stretch 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Phase 2 Push Strength":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Elevated push-up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Doorway row (feet closer to bar) 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Hip thrust hold 3x20 seconds rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest/shoulder mobility 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Phase 2 Lower & Core":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Squat to chair 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Single-leg hinge (balance hinge) 3x10..12 per side rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Plank with leg lift 3x20 seconds per side rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          hips & hamstrings stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 50m "Pull & Core Intensity":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Inverted row progression (feet closer to table) 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Push-up with clavicle cue (control) 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Side plank with hip dip 3x12 seconds per side rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          full body mobility 5 minutes
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Push Strength 2":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Decline push-up 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Doorway row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Glute bridge 3x12..20 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest/shoulder stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower Power & Core":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Squat to chair 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Hip hinge hold 3x25 seconds rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          Bicycle crunch 3x20 per side rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          lower body mobility 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 50m "Pull Strength & Mobility":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Inverted row progression 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Pike push-up progression 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Dead bug 3x12 per side rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic mobility 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Phase 3 Push & Control":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Elevated push-up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Doorway row with tempo 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Hip thrust hold 3x25 seconds rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest/shoulder mobility 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Phase 3 Lower & Core":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Squat to chair 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Single-leg hinge 3x10..12 per side rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Plank with shoulder taps 3x20 taps total rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          hips & hamstrings stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 55m "Phase 3 Pull & Core":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Inverted row progression 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Push-up to incline 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Pallof breath training (anti-rotation) 3x12 seconds per side rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          full body mobility 5 minutes
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Phase 3 Push Volume":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Decline push-up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Tempo push-up 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Glute bridge hold 3x30 seconds rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest/shoulder stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Phase 3 Lower & Core Power":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Squat to chair 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Hip hinge tempo 3x6..8 reps rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Side plank 3x25 seconds per side rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip flexor/quad stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 55m "Phase 3 Pull Strength & Stability":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Inverted row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Push-up with rotation (knees) 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Bird dog 3x12 per side rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic mobility 5 minutes
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Phase 3 Consolidation":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Elevated push-up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Inverted row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Glute bridge 3x12..20 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest/shoulder mobility 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Phase 3 Core & Balance":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Plank 3x40 seconds rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          Side plank 3x30 seconds per side rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          Dead bug 3x12 per side rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip flexor/quad stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 55m "Phase 3 Pull & Stability":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Inverted row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Push-up to incline 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Pallof press (if available space) 3x12 seconds per side rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          full body mobility 5 minutes
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Final Strength Readiness":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Decline push-up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Inverted row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Hip thrust hold 3x30 seconds rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          full body stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Phase 3 Review & Mobility":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Squat to chair 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Hip hinge tempo 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Side plank 3x30 seconds per side rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility sequence 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 60m "Test & Validate Progress":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Push-up max reps x3 sets (stop if form compromised) 3x to failure rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          Inverted row max reps x3 sets 3x to failure rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          Plank test 1 minute hold
        cooldown:
          celebratory stretch and breathing 5 minutes
